_comment: Halden Distribution Ltd. — P9 config-as-code sources. Applies to scripts/06-Export-HaldenConfigs.ps1 (Windows side) and scripts/07-export-configs.sh (Linux/OPNsense side). Each entry names a source config, where it is exported from, and how secrets are handled before it is committed to the halden-configs Git repository. Files that can contain secrets are either filtered or encrypted (git-crypt/SOPS) BEFORE first commit.
repository: halden-configs (private Git repo hosted on Gitea on OPS01 or a private GitHub repo)

sources.secret_handling: none required (XML reports contain no passwords)

sources.export: OUs, groups and privileged-group membership to CSV/JSON

sources.secret_handling: failover shared secret is excluded by -Leases:$false and server-scope export; verify before commit

sources.export: Export-DnsServerZone / zone files for AD-integrated zones

sources.secret_handling: exportPSK=NO removes the shared RADIUS secret
FILTERED (passwords, hashes, keys removed by scripts/07-export-configs.sh) or encrypted with git-crypt/SOPS; never committed raw
sshd host keys and any private keys are never copied

drift_detection.check: A changed file whose change date has no matching approved change record in GLPI (P10) raises an 'unauthorised change' High ticket.
